summary: Busy through road with no parked cars on this kerb and houses 12 m away.
reasons: Main road, no parking along this kerb

drivers.seclusion: Houses 12-19 m away on the kerb's own side, with little screening.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb is on a wide through road with no bay and no cars parked beside it.
drivers.traffic: Multi-lane through route with centre markings and a bus stop.
drivers.convention: Parking is on the opposite kerb only; none on this side.

sun_shade: Tree canopy shades the north end; the rest is open.
